about.p1: At Impera, we believe AI should work for you, not the other way around. The goal isn’t more tools. It’s less manual work, better decisions, and growth you can measure. We start by finding what is actually worth automating, and we tell you honestly what isn’t.
about.p2: Our name, derived from the Latin imperare, to command, reflects the promise: you stay in command of your business while the repetitive work runs itself.

guarantee.title: The Impera Performance Guarantee
guarantee.subtitle: We're so confident in our approach that we put our commitment in writing. Within <1>90 days</1> of starting:
guarantee.point1: A measurable result agreed upfront, such as hours saved, errors avoided, or faster turnaround, tracked against your starting baseline
guarantee.point2: Weekly progress reports showing what’s running, what it saves, and what comes next
guarantee.point3: Direct access to your specialist, response time under 24 hours
guarantee.promise: If we don't deliver measurable results in 90 days, we'll work an additional month at no cost until we do.
guarantee.promiseWhy: Why can we promise this? Because before we build anything, we measure your current process, agree on the result that counts, and only automate what pays back. If something isn’t worth automating, we’ll tell you.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you want to know before commanding your growth.
faq.q1: How is Impera different from a typical agency?
faq.a1: We don't outsource. Every strategy, build, and optimization is handled by senior specialists on our own team — never a subcontractor. That means faster iteration, direct accountability, and work that's actually informed by what we learn across every client we run.
faq.q2: What does the process actually look like?
faq.a2: Three steps: Survey, Build, Command. We start by mapping exactly where your time and money are leaking, then design and deploy the automation and campaigns ourselves, then hand you a business that runs itself — with you steering, not managing the process day to day.
faq.q3: What industries do you work with?
faq.a3: We specialize in legal, finance, real estate, healthcare, and construction — sectors where trust, compliance, and discretion matter as much as growth. Our approach transfers well beyond those, but that's where we've built the deepest playbooks.
faq.q4: Do I need existing automation or tech infrastructure in place?
faq.a4: No. Most clients come to us running everything manually. Part of the Survey phase is figuring out exactly what to build and in what order — you don't need anything set up beforehand.
faq.q5: What's the investment, and how is it structured?
faq.a5: It depends on scope — a single automation build looks very different from an ongoing growth partnership. We'll give you a clear number after the initial audit, with no vague retainers or hidden fees.
faq.q6: What happens after the automation is live?
faq.a6: We don't disappear. You get weekly performance reporting and direct access to your strategist, with response times under 24 hours, so the system keeps improving instead of quietly decaying.
